description: Instead of blocking videos or interrupting, the extension simply tracks when you enter YouTube from outside the site and provides helpful statistics about your browsing habits. Why use it? Many people open YouTube out of habit without realizing how often it happens. YouTube Click Tracker provides simple visibility into that behavior so you can make more intentional choices about when you visit the site. Plus, it's fun to see how long you can go without clicking on a YouTube link once.

name: ZENIT Tracks
tagline: Record and view your tracks in 3D Maps, import and export
description: ZENIT Tracks records and shows your tracks in beautiful 3D maps with different styles. You can record your own tracks, or import anyone else's tracks in GPX or KML formats. Export tracks is also supported to GPX, KML, CSV and TCX so you can share them
